var_sample_avia_oc.description: Configured mutation annotation relation from site.avia_table. Do not assume one row equals one unique mutation.
var_sample_avia_oc.logical_grain: Annotated variant observation; multiple cases, genes or transcripts may represent one event.
index_notes: All supplied indexes are NONUNIQUE. The _PK suffix is not proof of a primary key or row uniqueness.
Preserve VAR_SAMLE_AVIA_OC_COORD spelling exactly as supplied.
Column order is significant. These indexes suggest useful access paths but do not guarantee an execution plan or cheap query.

columns.name: chromosome
columns.description: Variant chromosome; coordinate convention must be confirmed before cross-dataset joins.

columns.name: start_pos
columns.description: Variant start coordinate; base convention requires review.

columns.name: end_pos
columns.description: Variant end coordinate; interval convention requires review.

columns.name: ref
columns.description: Reference allele representation; normalization conventions require review.

columns.name: alt
columns.description: Alternate allele representation; normalization conventions require review.

columns.name: case_id
columns.description: Analysis/case identifier; keep when distinguishing variant observations. Exact cross-case deduplication requires review.

columns.name: patient_id
columns.description: Patient identifier. Not by itself sufficient to authorize sample-level data.

columns.name: sample_id
columns.description: Sample identifier. For sample authorization use patient_id AND sample_id where both exist.

columns.name: type
columns.description: Mutation call source: somatic = paired tumor/normal; variants = tumor-only; germline = germline calls; rnaseq = RNA-seq calls. MCP ranseq is an API spelling mapped to rnaseq. A tumor-only call can have a somatic tier; never equate the tier context with the call source.

columns.name: somatic_level
columns.description: Somatic tier annotation; existing tools recognize Tier 1–4 prefixes and No Tier. Independent of mutation call source.

columns.name: germline_level
columns.description: Germline tier annotation; existing tools recognize Tier 1–4 prefixes and No Tier. Independent of mutation call source.

columns.name: gene
columns.description: Annotated gene symbol. Queries typically compare normalized uppercase symbols.

columns.name: maf
columns.description: Maximum population frequency, stored on a 0–1 scale.

columns.name: total_cov
columns.description: Total read coverage used by variant filters. Missing values may be excluded by numeric comparisons.

columns.name: vaf
columns.description: Variant allele fraction, stored on a 0–1 scale.

var_tier_avia.description: Germline and somatic tier annotations attached to mutation calls. A project can override the tier table with var_tier_table.
var_tier_avia.logical_grain: Variant/gene/call observation; approved join keys and uniqueness require review.

columns.name: case_id
columns.description: Analysis/case identifier; keep when distinguishing variant observations. Exact cross-case deduplication requires review.

columns.name: patient_id
columns.description: Patient identifier. Not by itself sufficient to authorize sample-level data.

columns.name: left_gene
columns.description: Left fusion partner gene. A gene query should consider either partner unless direction is explicitly requested.

columns.name: right_gene
columns.description: Right fusion partner gene. Preserve left/right order when the question is directional.

authorization_rules: This document is not an authorization mechanism or an approved SQL allowlist.
Bind authenticated user ID on the server. Validate every protected source and query branch before execution.
Sample-level sources require an authorized project_samples membership matching BOTH patient_id and sample_id.
Patient-level sources use project_patients plus user_projects. Do not use patient membership alone to authorize sample-level records.
Use EXISTS membership tests when appropriate to avoid duplicate counts across overlapping projects.
Do not infer access from projects.ispublic or grant administrator exceptions without an explicit application policy.
Case-level queries must join/correlate project_processed_cases to user_projects on project_id and bind authenticated user_id; patient_id plus case_id alone does not authorize access.
For sample-bearing case records, retain sample-level authorization until the interaction of case and sample membership is explicitly approved.
Expression sample lists contain identifiers and require the same project authorization as expression vectors.
analysis_rules: Always specify count unit: distinct patients, samples, variants, cases, genes or fusion pairs.
Tier annotation context differs from mutation call source. Empty paired-somatic results do not establish absence of somatic-tier tumor-only calls.
A source switch must be disclosed; tumor-only calls are not confirmed paired somatic calls.
Do not sum counts across overlapping cohorts as globally distinct patients.
Existing tools apply filters such as false-positive exclusion, coverage and allele frequency. Raw SQL must declare comparable filters or disclose differences.
Expression matrices and PCA coordinates are also file-backed in existing project workflows; this relational inventory does not expose all modalities.
VAF and MAF are fractions on a 0–1 scale: 5 percent means 0.05.
Expression sample list is TARGET='_list'; map each gene value to the sample at the same position. Verify vector lengths and matching dimensions; do not guess missing-value handling.
Survival time values are measured in days (user confirmed).

provenance.columns: Read-only Laravel database metadata inspection; no data rows or distinct value scans.
semantic_sources: User statements: library_type means capture method; sample diagnosis is Tissue Type.
provenance.user_update: User-supplied DDL/explanations and confirmations: sample_details name, variants spelling, TARGET='_list', positional expression alignment, VAF/MAF 0–1, mandatory user_projects, and five NONUNIQUE indexes.

review_required: Confirm physical primary/unique keys, foreign keys, and definitions of views.
Confirm all variant/tier join keys, including case_id, gene, sample and genome-build handling; current services differ.
Confirm coordinate conventions, and meanings for columns marked needs_review; VAF and MAF scales are confirmed 0–1.
Confirm project-specific variant tier/fusion table overrides and false-positive rules.
Define an approved read-only connection and SQL validation rules before enabling generated SQL.
Confirm exact project_values dimensions matching each gene vector to its TARGET='_list' row, plus missing-value encoding and handling of length mismatches.
Confirm whether case membership ever substitutes for sample membership; user_projects is mandatory for either authorization path.
